meanings: Elspet: Voss's grandmother, who kept the fire in her mother's harbour-house at Eldhythe (IV.5)
derivation: a name: names are names (no sense given); the Book's spelling, which the leaf-hand writes as it stands (e.l.s.p.e.t: onset sp, §2.5); unit S07 (IV.5)

meanings: Daveth: Elspet's brother, an axeman of the felling, home on a spar (IV.5); Merrick's father
derivation: a name: names are names (no sense given); the Book's spelling (d.a.v.e.th); unit S07 (IV.5)

meanings: Merrik: the Book's Merrick, eldest of the ship-masters, Daveth's son (IV.5)
derivation: a name: names are names (no sense given); spelled by the Book's romanisation, which writes /k/ as k at the end of a word after i (orrowen_v2 §2.4: Hesk, kyl), so the English Merrick is Merrik in the leaf; unit S07 (IV.5)

meanings: Yory: the Book's Jory, of Eldhythe, who whistled (I.3, IV.5, V.1, V.5)
derivation: a name: names are names (no sense given); the tongue has no j (orrowen_v2 §2.5) and writes the glide /j/ as y before a vowel (§2.4), so the English Jory is Yory in the leaf (said /'jori/); unit S07 (IV.5, V.1)

meanings: Enno: a cradle-name; with Della, the young pair (later sealed as Enrella)
derivation: a name: names are names (no sense given); unit S07 (V.1)

meanings: Della: a cradle-name; with Enno, the young pair (later sealed as Enrella)
derivation: a name: names are names (no sense given); a woman's cradle-name in -a (§5.12); unit S07 (V.1)

meanings: Wendhessa: the pair-name of Wendel and Tessa, the archivists of Eldhythe, whose seal is on Brenn's bundle (Of This Book, V.1)
derivation: canon formation (orrowen_v2 §3.10): Wen- (Wendel) + softened Tess- (t > dh) + the lintel -a, as Idrenna (Id- + S Denn- + -a); a pair-name takes a dual verb; unit S07 (V.1)

meanings: whistle; a tune whistled ('lip-song'); VN inthvellyl, whistling
derivation: inth 'a lip; a kiss' (O1082) + S vell 'a song; sing' (O2698; v unchanged) (compound: the head softened, §3.10), as sodhvell 'a skipping-song' (O2320); a song with no words in it, sung by the lips alone; unit S07 (IV.5, V.1)
